comment: The mine's wall tile set. A tile's position in this list is the layer index a level file's `texture: N` selects, so append rather than insert: renumbering re-textures every level that is already authored. `file` is optional and defaults to <name>.png. Four names are load-bearing because the renderer asks for them by name rather than a level choosing them - rock (pillar props), panel (robots and other props), hazard (door slabs) and hull (the ship) - and the game will not start without them. Every other tile is yours. `scroll` [u, v] and `turbulence` move a tile, and are applied only where a side sets `emissive`: an unlit wall has nothing to animate.
